CustomObject.description: Business-level catalog novelty event for the Buyer Group Catalog Pulse feature. It is NOT a raw copy of a Change Data Capture event: a thin curation layer translates a Product2 change into functional meaning (changeType, title, priority) before publishing. Consumed by an Apex subscriber that persists Catalog_Pulse_Item__c records. Publish After Commit so it only fires if the causing DML committed.
CustomObject.label: Catalog Pulse Event
